verdicts.reasoning: Seeds give two parts and ask for the whole (0 and 3; 1 and 2; 1+1; 1+2; 5+5; 1+6; 2 chicks and 1 more).

Provided in one thin form only: the whole plus one part, asking for the missing part. No item asks the pupil to produce a decomposition of a stated whole ('6 is 4 and ___') or more than one way to split a number, so the 'N is A and B' framing the competency itself models never appears.
Every item operates on whole numbers.
Totals are 2,3,3,3,3,6,7,7,10,10; the ceiling of 10 is reached and never exceeded in any stem or key. Distractors do exceed it, recorded as a content problem.

Nine of ten items are bare symbolic arithmetic or abstract 'parts/total' language with no object, no manipulative, and nothing to handle or count. Seed 103's chick pictures are semi-concrete at best; seed 127 invokes a balance in words only, with no objects on it. Seeds 11 and 23 are the clearest evidence: 'The two parts are 0 and 3' names parts of nothing at all.

incidental_findings.finding: The competency ENUMERATES six sub-cases by example -- 5 is 5 and 0; 4 and 1; 3 and 2; 2 and 3; 1 and 4; 0 and 5 -- and a pupil working this entire set meets each of them EXACTLY ZERO TIMES. The whole number 5 is never composed or decomposed. Ten items deliver four templates, six of them the same symbolic blank-fill; the total 3 appears four times while totals 1, 4, 5, 8, 9 never appear. The 'many ways to make one number' idea, the heart of this competency, appears never.
Undefined subject: 'The two parts are 0 and 3. What is the total?' -- parts of what? No object, no picture, no context, on a competency whose method clause is 'using concrete materials'.

Out-of-range distractors 15, 13, 15, 13 and 11 put two-digit numbers before pupils on a node explicitly bounded at 10. They are digit-concatenation error patterns (1+2 read as '13'), a defensible rationale, but transparently implausible, narrowing a 4-option item to a 3-option guess.
'Both sides balance evenly' refers to a balance the pupil cannot see and adds nothing the equation 6 + ? = 7 does not already state; 'What is the missing value?' is abstract register for G1 Q1.

Competency drift: these are plain addition-fact recall (1+1, 1+2, 5+5, 1+6) with no part-whole framing. A set where 6 of 10 items are symbolic blank-filling reads as 'add within 10', not 'compose and decompose numbers up to 10 using concrete materials'.
All ten keys are mathematically correct and consistent with their listed options; no wrong key and no second option also correct.
